objective: compare native z-score, clipped z-score, and fixed linear HU preprocessing under paired e4/d4 and e5/d4 public-VoxTell v123 fine-tuning

initialization.load_policy: load public model weights directly; do not initialize from any fine-tuned checkpoint

hu_audit.hu_policy: fixed NIfTI values are already materialized HU; do not apply DICOM slope/intercept again

preprocessing.shared_geometry: established image/target orientation fix, crop-to-nonzero in native geometry, no resampling, then 192^3 patch/window sampling
preprocessing.normalization_scope: normalize the complete cropped volume once before patch or sliding-window sampling; never normalize each patch independently

crop_clip1024_zscore_native_v1.normalization: clip HU to [-1024,1024], then z-score the complete cropped volume

crop_clip1024_linear_native_v1.normalization: clip HU to [-1024,1024], then divide by 1024

schedule.prompt_policy: multi-finding 2 positive + 1 negative; one-finding 1 positive + 2 negatives; every selected positive nonempty in its sampled patch

shared_training.augmentation: none added beyond VoxTell patch sampling
shared_training.execution: full-state segmented training with global val20 barriers at epochs 5/20/40/60/80/100
shared_training.resume_state: network weights, SGD momentum, AMP scaler, Python/NumPy/PyTorch CPU and CUDA RNG streams, global update, polynomial LR horizon, and deterministic schedule cursor

v123_e4d4_zscore.purpose: e4/d4 z-score anchor and exp006 encoder-LR extension

v123_e4d4_clip1024_zscore.purpose: test robust clipping while retaining per-case z-score

v123_e4d4_clip1024_linear.purpose: test fixed HU calibration under the existing InstanceNorm-based model

v123_e5d4_zscore.purpose: same-workflow replication of the exp006 native e5/d4 result

v123_e5d4_clip1024_zscore.purpose: test robust clipping with the less aggressive e5/d4 learning-rate profile

v123_e5d4_clip1024_linear.purpose: test fixed linear HU with the less aggressive e5/d4 learning-rate profile

validation.eval_policy: Only GPUs 0-2 are used. Within each LR profile, at every epoch 5/20/40/60/80/100 milestone all trainers exit, all three val20 evaluations run concurrently on their assigned GPUs, and no arm resumes until evaluation and the canonical report update succeed. Epoch-100 val200 follows epoch-100 val20.

launch_policy.e5d4_authorization: User explicitly ordered the three-arm e5/d4 rerun with GPUs 0-2, synchronous val20 barriers, final val200, and report updates after every barrier.
launch_policy.orchestration: host-side idempotent milestone state machine with separate Docker containers per training, evaluation, and reporting stage

differences_from_exp006: The completed e4/d4 profile uses encoder/decoder LR 1e-4/1e-4.
The paired e5/d4 rerun uses encoder/decoder LR 1e-5/1e-4 and includes all three normalization variants.
Two arms intentionally change CT normalization while retaining identical geometry, targets, schedule, prompts, model, optimizer, and loss.
Training is segmented at validation milestones with full optimizer/scaler/RNG resume; GPU 3 is not exposed to the experiment.
differences_from_voxtell_pretraining: Training uses ReXGroundingCT text prompts and released 4D finding masks.
One-finding cases use the 1 positive + 2 negative fallback prompt policy.
Fine-tuning uses batch size 1, 100 optimizer updates per epoch, and the v123 empty-target/weighted-BCE loss.
Two experimental arms apply CT-specific clipping or fixed linear HU normalization.
